dependency_gate: Execute only after loop1 consumer/clock/HE results synchronized in LOOP1_SYNC.json
scope: Pure H one-temperature collapsed Peebles prescribed matter-only FLRW benchmark; actual REC source→new REI consumer→native trajectory→BASS cold-Thomson visibility. This is not EoR, FT03 extension or full cosmological admission.

initial_state.selection: explicit benchmark initial condition, not Saha equilibrium or observational fit

native_integration.method: explicit RK4, equal redshift cells, source evaluated at every stage, hard reject invalid state
native_integration.opacity_sampling: half-step RK4 midpoint state, midpoint proper density; each q held constant on its interval
native_integration.clock_map: analytic normal and conformal time edges; effective a=dt/deta per cell; chi=c*eta

independent_reference.method: SciPy DOP853 on separately written source formula, rtol=2e-12,atol=2e-14
independent_reference.reference_independence: same published coefficients/profile by design; independent source formula and ODE solver, no native calls inside reference
